cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Complete the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to fill the missing gaps in an account without revealing which answer matters most to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three taps, like you. Log opened. What were the mileage, fuel level and person at the wheel after nine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was counting change. You mean who dented the car?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Change checked. I mean all three blanks. Start with mileage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who was driving I remember. The rest means going down six flights to the glovebox.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll fetch the book and bring you tea on the way back. Then give me the whole row in order.

reason: Make copied counting taps a mistaken log-opening convention. A covers by doing the retrieval work B names instead of immediately taking only the easy identity answer.
